📱 PushControl — Notification Control

 Version: 1.2 

 Developer: Nokolay Datchenko

 About the app: Notification Control is your personal tool for flexible management, filtering, and organizing your notification shade. The app was created to free you from spam, intrusive ads, and to ensure you don't miss truly important messages from the apps you need. 

 🔒 Security and Permissions:

 To ensure full and stable operation on modern Android versions, the app requires two key permissions:
 — Access to the list of apps (QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES): This permission is required solely to display a list of apps installed on your tablet/phone. This allows you to manually select which apps you want to manage & which ones to leave unchanged.
 — Sending notifications (POST_NOTIFICATIONS): Required to display important system summaries, background monitoring service alerts, and neatly organized notifications instead of cluttered notifications in the notification shade.

 🛡️ Data Privacy

 We value your privacy. The app does not collect, save, or transmit data about your installed packages or notification texts to third-party servers. All processing, filtering, and analysis of push notifications occurs strictly locally on your device (in a secure SQLite database).

 ⓘ Feedback

 If you have any questions, suggestions for improving the interface, or if you find a bug, please contact us through the app store or by emailing the developer's support team.
